Hi Adam, nice to meet you, Thanks, Michelle for the introduction.
I'd be happy to talk -- we're working on coming up with a more coherent strategy
here, and I'm really interested in hearing what you and your partners are thinking.
Copying my colleague, Diana.
Please let me know when are some good times to chat.
Best, Josh
On Thu, Feb 18, 2021 at 2:49 PM Michelle Parker <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Hi Adam,
Great to hear from you! It's been ages. I hope you and yours are well.
I'd like to introduce you to Josh Machleder, Senior Media and Internet Freedom
Advisor in the Democracy, Rights, and Governance Center. He is our Agency's
lead on Disinformation and is best placed to engage with InterAction and its
members on this critical issue.
Josh,
I'd like to introduce Adam Fivenson, who has been a fantastic sounding board
and partner in convening InterAction members to discuss and provide feedback
on our Digital Strategy work.
Take care,
Michelle
On Wed, Feb 17, 2021 at 4:45 PM Fivenson, Adam
> wrote:
